sources.quote: 7.1 The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts

findings.why: The meeting premise is wrong. Revision 4 of Aurelia's manual replaces revision 3 and is the one in force. It requires written approval (PPAP resubmission) before shipping after a coating change, not notification only. It also requires notification 90 days before implementation. The change to BK-330 zinc flake therefore needs Aurelia's written approval first. Nothing in force already covers it. The zinc flake coating is in the catalogue and contains only zinc, so no restricted-substance or missing-evidence finding applies. The documents do not show which customer(s) BK-330 serves. This finding assumes Aurelia, as stated in the meeting. Nordhavn's requirements would also need checking if BK-330 serves that customer.
